papers.abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires memory, but not necessarily inside the action policy. To address such tasks, current agentic systems often combine VLAs with planners and geometric tools, sometimes using additional depth or calibrated geometry. These systems confound attribution: gains may come from richer observations or alternative motor tools, while failures may stem from either the policy or an under-specified language interface. We isolate this question through a deliberately constrained design: less tool breadth, but greater interface bandwidth. 2AM makes a multimodal Agent the sole holder of task memory and a single RGB-based, episodically stateless Action Model the sole executor of task-relevant motion. The Agent compiles interaction history into subtask language and optional 2D grasp, place, and move hints that bind its physical intention at different time scales. To teach this steerability to the VLA, we augment demonstrations with structured hint labels and train under condition dropout, spatial noise, and temporal jitter to tolerate imperfect Agent outputs. On LIBERO-Mem, without depth, online geometry, or planner-based object motion, 2AM reaches 76.3% average completion, a 61.5-point improvement over the strongest reported baseline of 14.8%, together with 63.0% relaxed and 11.8% strict success. These results show that task memory can remain Agent-side. They further show that Action Model capability depends not only on what the policy has learned, but on how precisely the Agent can steer it. Project website: agent-mem-action-model.github.io

analysis.key_results: 在 LIBERO-Mem 上达到 76.3% 的平均完成率，比之前最强的基线 14.8% 提高了 61.5 个百分点；宽松成功率为 63.0%，严格成功率为 11.8%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了 2AM 框架，将任务记忆完全交给一个多模态 Agent，用一个仅基于 RGB、无状态的 Action Model 作为唯一执行器，通过语言和 2D 空间提示实现对 VLA 的精确引导。
analysis.method: Agent 将交互历史编译为子任务语言和可选的 2D 抓取、放置、移动提示，并通过条件丢弃、空间噪声和时间抖动训练 VLA 以容忍不完美的 Agent 输出。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 2AM 通过将任务记忆置于多模态智能体端，仅用 RGB 和可操纵的动作模型完成长程操作，在 LIBERO-Mem 上显著提升成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接改进 VLA 在长程操作中的记忆管理和可操纵性，通过智能体端记忆与动作模型分离的设计提升机器人操作性能，与 VLA 主题高度相关。

figures.caption: Agent-side memory, expressed through steering. The Agent Model consolidates task history and reasons about the next physical intention. A compositional command grounds that intention as subtask language plus optional grasp, place, and move cues. The Action Model receives this command with current RGB and robot state, but no task history. It then executes every task-relevant motion. Fresh RGB closes the loop for the Agent to update and re-steer.

Stage labels, object annotations, contact and object motion, and projected robot motion recover subtask, grasp, place, and move supervision without a model teacher. Structured condition dropout, spatial noise, and future-window sampling expose the policy to incomplete and imprecise steering. One Action Model consumes the surviving conditions, RGB cameras, and robot state and learns 16-step action chunks with a flow-matching objective.

papers.abstract: World models (WMs) have demonstrated strong potential for end-to-end autonomous driving by learning predictive representations of future scene dynamics. However, generating future videos during inference introduces substantial computational overhead, leading many recent driving WMs to adopt a single front camera as input for efficient deployment. This design restricts spatial coverage in safety-critical maneuvers such as lane changes, merges, and turns. To address this limitation, we propose SV-WAM, a surround-view world-action model (WAM) that preserves full six-camera observations while maintaining efficient inference. SV-WAM leverages future-video prediction as dense training supervision for action learning within a shared generative model, rather than as an inference-time output. At the core of this design is an action-centered causal mask that prevents action tokens from attending to future-video tokens during joint action-video denoising. Consequently, the video branch can be discarded at deployment, enabling efficient action-only planning. Furthermore, we introduce a differentiable drivable-area compliance regularizer that penalizes vehicle-footprint corners approaching or crossing drivable boundaries, improving planning safety and boundary awareness. Extensive experiments on the closed-loop NAVSIMv2 benchmark and the open-loop nuScenes benchmark demonstrate that SV-WAM achieves state-of-the-art planning performance with low inference latency and competitive zero-shot transfer capability.

analysis.key_results: 在NAVSIMv2和nuScenes基准上达到最先进的规划性能，同时保持低推理延迟和具竞争力的零样本迁移能力。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SV-WAM，一种利用未来视频预测作为训练监督、在推理时丢弃视频分支以实现高效动作规划的环视世界-动作模型。
analysis.method: 采用动作中心的因果掩码在联合动作-视频去噪中防止动作令牌关注未来视频令牌；引入可微可行域合规正则项提高规划安全性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种保持环视输入但推理时仅使用动作分支的高效世界-动作模型，用于端到端自动驾驶规划。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接属于WAM（世界-动作模型）范畴，并针对自动驾驶机器人策略，通过高效推理设计解决环视输入与计算开销的矛盾。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) have shown strong potential in autonomous driving by leveraging multimodal pretraining for instruction following, visual reasoning, and scene-level generalization. In robotic manipulation, scaling VLA fine-tuning across multiple robot setups--especially when unifying representations across embodiments--has been shown to improve in-dataset performance and cross-embodiment generalization; in autonomous driving, however, VLAs remain largely trained on individual datasets and are rarely evaluated for zero-shot transfer to unseen datasets and camera rigs; furthermore naively adding more datasets to the training data does not necessarily lead to better performance within seen embodiments. To address these problems, we study multi-dataset training for the driving task and BEV-Forcing, an auxiliary objective that transfers ground-plane object-layout information from a specialized Bird's-Eye-View model into the VLA backbone. By encouraging the model to represent object position through a shared BEV spatial interface, we show that an auxiliary task such as BEV-Forcing can improve both in-distribution and out-of-distribution performance when training on a small number of camera rigs. As the number of training embodiments increases, however, the benefits of the auxiliary task are reduced; we present this as evidence that new techniques in the literature may see their benefits diminish when simply scaling up training diversity, which motivates presenting results taking into account data scaling.

analysis.key_results: BEV-Forcing在小规模相机配置下提升分布内和分布外性能；训练平台数量增加时其优势减弱。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出BEV-Forcing辅助目标，将专用鸟瞰图模型的地面物体布局信息迁移到VLA骨干中，并证明其在小规模训练配置下可提升分布内和分布外性能。
analysis.method: 多数据集训练结合BEV-Forcing辅助目标，鼓励模型通过共享BEV空间接口表示物体位置。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文研究驾驶视觉-语言-动作模型的多数据集训练，提出BEV-Forcing辅助目标以提升跨数据集和相机配置的零样本迁移能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接研究VLA模型在自动驾驶中的跨平台泛化，提出辅助任务以改善零样本迁移，对VLA在机器人领域的应用有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Siri Expressive Voices synthesize rich, configurable speech in real time and entirely on device, powered by AFM 3 Core Advanced, Apple's most powerful on-device foundation model. This work presents the memory-efficient audio synthesis architecture behind that capability: a detokenizer that converts the semantic audio tokens emitted by the foundation model into high-fidelity audio within the tight compute and memory budget of the Scalable Matrix Extension (SME). We convert semantic audio tokens to a residual vector quantization (RVQ) representation with a three-component design, a streaming encoder, a temporal decoder, and a depth decoder, that systematically decouples temporal and depth processing. A single reusable depth decoder with Diffusion Transformer (DiT)-style stage conditioning generates all RVQ levels autoregressively, replacing the dedicated per-level decoders of prior multi-decoder architectures, while causal sliding window attention with fixed-window key-value caching yields constant memory complexity independent of sequence length. Deployed on the AMX, the detokenizer sustains roughly 10 ms per generation step, about 16x faster than real time, with a peak runtime memory of only 21 MB and 329 MB of on-device assets, enabling continuous streaming synthesis of 20-320 seconds of audio. This constant, small footprint replaces the linear and quadratic memory scaling of conventional transformer- and GAN-based approaches. Ablation studies validate the key architectural components, and audio quality assessment confirms that the architecture maintains synthesis fidelity while achieving efficiency gains over existing methods. Operating at a 1-billion-parameter activation size within AFM 3 Core Advanced, it improves Mean Opinion Score by +0.28 overall (4.15 vs. 3.87) and by +0.42 on conversational speech (4.24 vs. 3.82) over the prior on-device text-to-speech system.

analysis.key_results: 在AMX上每步约10ms，约16倍实时；峰值运行时内存21MB，设备端资产329MB；支持20-320秒连续流式合成；在AFM 3 Core Advanced上MOS总分+0.28（4.15 vs 3.87），对话语音MOS+0.42（4.24 vs 3.82）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种内存高效的音频合成架构，通过解耦时间与深度处理、使用单一深度解码器替代多解码器、因果滑动窗口注意力与固定窗口KV缓存，实现恒定内存复杂度的连续音频合成。
analysis.method: 采用残差向量量化(RVQ)表示，由流式编码器、时间解码器和深度解码器三部分构成；单一深度解码器使用DiT风格阶段条件生成所有RVQ层级；因果滑动窗口注意力与固定窗口KV缓存实现恒定内存复杂度。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出一种内存高效的音频合成架构，通过解耦时间与深度处理、使用单一深度解码器实现残差向量量化，在设备端实现约16倍实时的低内存音频生成。

papers.abstract: Action-conditioned video world models predict future observations from an initial observation and an action signal. We propose robot-factored world models (RoFacto), which move two robot-specific factors outside the world model to separate action realization from scene-response prediction. First, action realization: each command sequence is rolled through the robot's own controller and kinematics without scene contact into a deployment-available nominal trajectory that does not require future realized states. Second, robot rendering: this nominal trajectory is rendered through the robot URDF, factoring the robot's geometry, kinematics, and appearance out of the model and into explicit rendered robot geometry. Paired end-effector and scene depth provide geometric cues for contact and occlusion, while camera-aware static RGB context and rendered robot geometry form a shared visual interface across viewpoints and embodiments through which the model learns scene responses. Our experiments show that the rendered interface outperforms vector-conditioned baselines, supports transfer to unseen robot embodiments, and generates robot manipulation videos from retargeted human demonstrations.

analysis.key_results: 实验表明，渲染接口优于向量条件基线，支持未见过机器人实施例的迁移，并能从重定向的人类演示生成机器人操作视频。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出RoFacto框架，将机器人特定因素（动作实现和机器人渲染）从世界模型中分解出来，通过渲染接口改善跨视角和跨实施例的泛化能力。
analysis.method: 将命令序列通过机器人控制器和运动学生成标称轨迹，再通过URDF渲染机器人几何，与末端执行器和场景深度配对，结合相机感知的静态RGB上下文，形成共享视觉接口，学习场景响应。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出机器人分解世界模型（RoFacto），将动作实现和机器人渲染从世界模型中分离出来，通过显式渲染机器人几何和相机感知的静态RGB上下文，学习场景响应，从而支持跨视角和跨实施例的转移。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文属于世界模型与机器人操作领域，与VLA/WAM主题高度相关；通过机器人渲染分解动作实现和机器人外观，提高世界模型的跨实施例和跨视角泛化能力，为机器人操作世界模型提供了新方法。

papers.abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have shown strong potential for industrial anomaly detection (IAD) by providing image-level anomaly judgments and interpretable reasoning. However, reliably translating generated judgments into precise pixel-level localization remains challenging. We propose \textbf{M}ixed-Trajectory \textbf{O}n-\textbf{P}olicy \textbf{D}istillation for Language-Guided Industrial \textbf{A}nomaly Detection (MOPDA), the first framework to introduce on-policy self-distillation into LVLM-based IAD. For judgment learning, \method introduces \textbf{Mixed-Trajectory Supervision}, combining student-generated on-policy trajectories with evidence-conditioned teacher trajectories under a shared token-level distillation objective. Student trajectories preserve supervision on deployment-relevant response paths, while teacher trajectories provide complementary evidence-conditioned supervision. For dense localization, \textbf{Language-guided Visual Anchoring} uses the final judgment as a compact semantic condition to construct image-specific normal and abnormal anchors, which are contrasted with dense visual features to produce anomaly maps. This keeps language as semantic guidance while grounding pixel-level responses in visual evidence. Under a strict cross-dataset zero-shot protocol on five IAD benchmarks, \method outperforms the evaluated LVLM-based baselines on most detection, localization, and judgment metrics while remaining competitive with CLIP-based methods. Ablations further validate both mixed-trajectory supervision and final-judgment conditioning.

analysis.key_results: 在五个IAD基准的严格跨数据集零样本协议下，该方法在多数检测、定位和判断指标上优于所评估的基于LVLM的方法，并与基于CLIP的方法保持竞争力。
analysis.main_contribution: 首次将在线策略自蒸馏引入基于LVLM的工业异常检测，提出混合轨迹监督和语言引导视觉锚定模块。
analysis.method: 混合轨迹监督结合学生生成的在线策略轨迹和证据条件的教师轨迹，在共享token级蒸馏目标下学习；语言引导视觉锚定利用最终判断作为语义条件构建正常/异常锚点，与密集视觉特征对比生成异常图。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出首个将在线策略自蒸馏引入基于大视觉语言模型的工业异常检测框架，融合混合轨迹监督与语言引导视觉锚定以提升像素级定位。

papers.abstract: Imitation Learning aims to learn skills from extensive observations and demonstrations for robots, so it suffers from data scarcity and environment generalization. The existing methods predominantly focus on imitation from in-domain tasks and consequently struggle with generalization to unseen tasks. To bridge this generalization gap, we propose the \textbf{D}ynamics-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{M}eta-\textbf{I}mitation (DAMI) framework. By integrating meta-learning to construct a shared skill space, DAMI equips agents for rapid adaptation to novel tasks. We introduce the Visual-Motor Trajectory (VMT) module to capture complex spatio-temporal dynamics within the task latent space. Furthermore, we propose the Unpaired Unified Task (U2T) block to fuse unstructured multimodal observations. To coordinate these representations, we integrate a Task-Conditioned Feature Modulation (TCFM) mechanism customized for modulating low-level 3D features. By capturing intrinsic dynamics from a random complete reference demonstration, our framework learns the underlying task logic rather than memorizing static cues, ensuring effective generalization. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world settings demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art baselines regarding direct inference on seen tasks and adaptation to unseen tasks via few-shot fine-tuning.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真和真实世界实验中，在已见任务的直接推理和未见任务的少样本微调适应上均优于现有最佳方法。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Dynamics-Aware Meta-Imitation (DAMI)框架，集成元学习共享技能空间、Visual-Motor Trajectory模块和Unpaired Unified Task块，并设计Task-Conditioned Feature Modulation机制。
analysis.method: 元学习构建共享技能空间；Visual-Motor Trajectory (VMT)模块捕捉任务潜在空间中的复杂时空动态；Unpaired Unified Task (U2T)块融合非结构化多模态观测；Task-Conditioned Feature Modulation (TCFM)调制低级3D特征。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出DAMI框架，通过元学习、视觉-运动轨迹建模和任务条件特征调制，实现机器人操作技能的跨任务泛化和快速适应。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作面向机器人操作技能的跨任务泛化，利用多模态观测和动态建模学习任务逻辑，属于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略学习范畴，对本站VLA主题具有直接研究价值。

papers.abstract: Whole-body humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinating the robot's entire kinematic chain. However, most existing systems typically decouple the upper and lower bodies into separate controllers, limiting such coordination and yielding behaviors similar to those of a wheeled dual-arm platform. In this paper, we ask what it takes to build a whole-body native vision-language-action (VLA) model that maps language and pixels directly to all of the humanoid's degrees of freedom. We conduct a systematic empirical study organized as a roadmap of one-variable-at-a-time experiments across three phases: whole-body teleoperation, VLA model design, and heterogeneous co-training. Our study yields several intriguing findings: a joint-based whole-body teleoperation interface outperforms alternatives that only partially expose the humanoid's degrees of freedom; a VLA pretrained on static and wheeled dual-arm platforms transfers surprisingly well to a humanoid's full action space; and co-training with HuMI, the humanoid analog of UMI, extends the policy to new objects and instructions without additional whole-body teleoperation on those targets. Following this roadmap yields OpenHLM, an open-source recipe for whole-body humanoid loco-manipulation. In a challenging long-horizon task that spans a wide vertical range of the humanoid, OpenHLM outperforms two state-of-the-art humanoid VLA baselines (GR00T N1.6 and $\Psi_0$) using less than half the total demonstration time. Our code, training data, and model checkpoints are available at [https://openhlm-project.github.io/].

analysis.key_results: OpenHLM在具有挑战性的长时程任务中超越了两种最先进的人形VLA基线（GR00T N1.6和Psi_0），且使用的演示时间不到基线的一半。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了OpenHLM，一个开源的全身人形机器人运动操纵配方，并通过系统实验揭示了有关全身遥操作、VLA模型设计和异质协同训练的关键发现。
analysis.method: 采用三阶段的单变量实验路线图：全身遥操作、VLA模型设计、异质协同训练，最终得到OpenHLM模型。

papers.abstract: We propose a sensor-guided adaptive contrastive learning framework for visual representation learning in PointGoal navigation. During training, privileged LiDAR sensing guides the contrastive objective through a geometry-aware similarity metric and adaptive temperature scaling, encouraging visual embeddings to capture navigation-relevant structure rather than scene-specific appearance. The resulting encoder is pretrained independently, frozen, and used as the perceptual backbone for reinforcement learning, decoupling representation learning from policy optimization. We further introduce a cross-stage domain mismatch between representation pretraining and policy learning to suppress environment-specific shortcuts and promote reliance on task-relevant features. Extensive experiments in high-fidelity simulation demonstrate that our approach significantly improves policy-level scene transfer across diverse indoor and outdoor environments. At deployment, the agent relies only on monocular RGB observations together with standard task-related inputs such as goal position and proprioceptive signals, without access to LiDAR or other privileged sensors. Our method outperforms large pretrained vision models and standard contrastive baselines under severe appearance and semantic shifts. We also release a multimodal dataset to support future research on privileged-guided visual representation learning for navigation. The code is available at:

analysis.key_results: 在高保真仿真中，该方法在多种室内外环境下显著提升策略级场景迁移性能；在严重外观和语义偏移下优于大型预训练视觉模型和标准对比基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出传感器引导的自适应对比学习框架，通过几何感知相似性度量和自适应温度缩放，利用特权 LiDAR 引导视觉表征学习；引入跨阶段域不匹配以增强任务相关特征学习；发布多模态数据集。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出一种传感器引导的自适应对比学习框架，利用特权 LiDAR 引导视觉表征学习，从而提升 PointGoal 导航策略在跨场景下的鲁棒迁移能力。

papers.abstract: World models require state tracking, which is the ability to maintain a correct latent state across action sequences. Existing benchmarks are often synthetic or language-based, limiting their value as tests of structured state updates in realistic domains. We introduce Chess-World-Model, a large-scale state-tracking benchmark built from 10 million real chess games, where models predict the exact board state reached after a sequence of legal moves. Alongside a held-out real-game split, we include an out-of-distribution test set of uniformly random legal play both at its original trajectory lengths and after matching the human-game length distribution. This tests whether models learn the transition rules rather than shortcuts from common human positions. Prior theoretical and empirical work has shown that Transformers struggle to state-track, while input-dependent linear RNNs require expressive state-transition matrices to do so. We therefore benchmark a causal Transformer, block-diagonal SLiCE, Mamba-3, and Gated DeltaNet with negative eigenvalues under a matched interface and training protocol. The recurrent models strongly outperform the Transformer at approximately 3 and 8 million parameters. Real-game performance largely saturates by the 18 million parameter scale, but length-matched random evaluation continues to distinguish architectures through the largest tested scale of approximately 43 million parameters. Additionally, ablations show that less expressive state-transition mechanisms generally reduce performance on the out-of-distribution splits. Together, these results establish Chess-World-Model as a practical large-scale benchmark for state tracking that exposes failures model scale would otherwise conceal.

analysis.key_results: 循环模型在约3M和8M参数规模下显著优于Transformer；真实游戏性能在18M参数规模饱和，但长度匹配随机评估在最大43M参数下仍能区分架构；消融显示表达力较弱的状态转移机制降低分布外性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了Chess-World-Model基准，包含1000万真实棋局和分布外随机走法测试集，用于评估模型在动作序列中的状态跟踪能力。
analysis.method: 构建大规模国际象棋状态跟踪基准，包含真实游戏和长度匹配的随机走法评估，并在统一接口和训练协议下比较Transformer、SLiCE、Mamba-3和Gated DeltaNet等模型。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该摘要介绍了一个基于真实国际象棋游戏的大规模状态跟踪基准，用于测试模型序列动作后的精确状态预测能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作关注状态跟踪和世界模型的基准构建，与机器人世界模型中的状态跟踪需求有方法论关联，可借鉴其评估思想，但不直接涉及VLA或机器人动作预测。

papers.abstract: Ternary Vision Transformers offer substantial model compression, however state-of-the-art methods only ternarize the encoder layers, leaving patch embeddings, LayerNorm parameters, and classifier heads in full precision. In compact models targeting resource-constrained processors, such as microcontrollers, these remaining full-precision components determine the total memory footprint, severely limiting deployment efficiency and on-device feasibility. In this work, we introduce a fully ternarized Vision Transformer in which all weight matrices and normalization parameters are ternarized, while activations remain 8-bit (FTerViT). To this end, we introduce two novel operators: TernaryBitConv2d with per-channel scaling for patch embedding and TernaryLayerNorm. FTerViT is trained using knowledge distillation, followed by a lightweight quantization-aware recovery phase. On a matched DeiT-S backbone, FTerViT reaches 77.47% ImageNet-1K top-1 at 5.81 MB, +3.27 pp over TerViT. With the stronger DeiT-III-S backbone at 384x384 resolution, our ternary W2A8 model achieves 82.43% at 6.09 MB (~15x compression, -2.42 pp vs. FP32). This backbone- and resolution-advantaged result exceeds prior ternary ViTs by up to 8 pp. Finally, we demonstrate the first implementation of ternary vision transformers on a dual-core Xtensa LX7 microcontroller inside the ESP32-S3 system-on-chip. By deploying FTerViT-Small (based on DeiT-III-Small at 224x224 resolution, 5.81 MB), we achieve 79.64% ImageNet-1K top-1 accuracy.

analysis.key_results: 在DeiT-S骨干上达到77.47% ImageNet-1K top-1（5.81 MB），比TerViT提高3.27个百分点；在DeiT-III-S 384x384上达到82.43%（6.09 MB，约15倍压缩）；在ESP32-S3微控制器上首次部署三值ViT，FTerViT-Small达到79.64% top-1。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了完全三值化的视觉Transformer FTerViT，并引入TernaryBitConv2d和TernaryLayerNorm两个新算子，实现了所有层参数的三值化。
analysis.method: 使用知识蒸馏训练，随后进行轻量级量化感知恢复；引入带逐通道缩放的三值卷积和三层归一化算子。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: FTerViT提出一种完全三值化的视觉Transformer，将所有权重矩阵和归一化参数三值化，激活保持8位，并在微控制器上实现部署。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于视觉Transformer的模型量化，不直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人技术，但其全三值化方法对资源受限设备上的视觉模型部署具有潜在参考价值。

papers.abstract: Both full fine-tuning (Full FT) and parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as LoRA introduce weight updates without accounting for the spectral structure established during pretraining. As a result, noisy gradients from limited fine-tuning data can perturb robust pretrained features. We identify spectral preconditioning as the missing ingredient: reparameterizing each weight matrix through its full-rank singular value decomposition (SVD) and freezing one singular basis constrains updates to the pretrained column space, yielding a preconditioned optimization scheme that outperforms unconstrained Full FT at the same trainable parameter count. Building on this insight, we propose FuRA (Full-Rank Adaptation), an efficient full-rank adaptation framework based on a block tensor-train factorization W = LSR, where the large core L is fixed to the pretrained block-wise SVD basis, while only the compact core R and the block-wise singular values S are optimized. This design simultaneously provides full-rank spectral preconditioning, preserves full-rank update expressivity, and achieves parameter, memory, and step-time efficiency comparable to LoRA. FuRA consistently outperforms Full FT across multiple settings, including LLM fine-tuning (+1.37 on LLaMA-3-8B commonsense reasoning), LLM reinforcement learning for mathematical reasoning, and visual instruction tuning for VLMs. Furthermore, the 4-bit quantized variant, QFuRA, also surpasses QLoRA. Code is available at https://github.com/yequanzhao/FuRA

analysis.key_results: FuRA在多种设置下持续优于全参数微调：LLM微调（LLaMA-3-8B常识推理+1.37）、数学推理的LLM强化学习、VLM视觉指令微调；QFuRA也优于QLoRA。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FuRA（Full-Rank Adaptation），一种基于块张量列因子分解的全秩参数高效微调方法，通过固定预训练SVD基实现谱预条件，在保持全秩更新表达能力的同时达到与LoRA相当的高效性。
analysis.method: FuRA使用块张量列分解W=LSR，固定L为预训练的分块SVD基，仅优化紧凑核心R和分块奇异值S；同时提供4位量化变体QFuRA。

papers.abstract: Uniform random rotations (URRs) are a common preprocessing step in modern quantization approaches used for gradient compression, inference acceleration, KV-cache compression, model weight quantization, and approximate nearest-neighbor search in vector databases. In practice, URRs are often replaced by randomized Hadamard transforms (RHTs), which preserve orthogonality while admitting fast implementations. The remaining issue is the performance for worst-case inputs. With a URR, each coordinate is distributed as a shifted beta distribution, which converges to a Gaussian distribution in high dimensions. Generally, one RHT is not suitable in the worst case, as individual coordinates can be far from these distributions. We show that after composing two RHTs on any $d$-sized input vector, the marginal distribution of every fixed coordinate of the normalized rotated vector is within $O(d^{-1/2})$ of a standard Gaussian both in Kolmogorov distance and in $1$-Wasserstein distance. We then plug these bounds into the analyses of modern compression schemes, namely DRIVE and QUIC-FL, and show that two RHTs achieve performance that asymptotically matches URRs. However, while two RHTs suffice for scalar quantization, they may be insufficient for Vector Quantization (VQ), which depends on the joint distribution across fixed-size blocks of coordinates (as opposed to only marginal distribution convergence for single coordinates). We prove that a composition of three RHTs leads to decaying coordinate covariance. This ensures that any fixed, bounded, multi-dimensional VQ codebook optimized for URRs has the same expected error when using three RHTs, up to an additive term that vanishes with the dimension. Finally, because practical inputs are rarely adversarial, we propose a linear-time $O(d)$ check on the input's moments to dynamically adapt the number of RHTs used at runtime to improve performance.

analysis.key_results: 两层RHT在Kolmogorov和1-Wasserstein距离下与标准高斯的偏差为O(d^{-1/2})；三层RHT使任意固定有界VQ码本的期望误差与均匀旋转相差随维度消失的加性项。
analysis.main_contribution: 证明了使用两层随机Hadamard变换可在Kolmogorov距离和1-Wasserstein距离下逼近标准高斯分布，三层可降低坐标协方差，使向量量化误差与均匀随机旋转渐近一致，并提出线性时间输入矩检查来自适应决定使用层数。
analysis.method: 理论分析随机Hadamard变换的分布收敛性，结合DRIVE和QUIC-FL压缩方案，并设计基于输入矩的运行时自适应机制。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文证明两层随机Hadamard变换可使边际分布逼近高斯分布，三层可控制坐标协方差，从而在理论上匹配均匀随机旋转的性能，并提出运行时自适应检查。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文是独立的模型量化理论工作，不直接涉及VLA或WAM，但其关于随机Hadamard变换的保证可指导VLA/WAM模型中权重和激活量化的预处理选择。

papers.abstract: The inception of Large Language Models (LLMs) has catalyzed AI adoption in the finance sector, yet their reliability in complex, jurisdiction-specific tasks like Indian Chartered Accountancy (CA) remains limited. The models display difficulty in executing numerical tasks which require multiple steps while also needing advanced knowledge about legal regulations and the method of scaling their operations is not feasible in settings which have limited access to resources. We present CA-ThinkFlow as a parameter-efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework which operates with a 14B, 4-bit-quantized reasoning model, 14B-DeepSeek-R1, and a layout-aware Docling extraction system which maintains document structure during extraction. CA-ThinkFlow uses a basic RAG method which automatically adds retrieved information into the prompt, while it depends on the model's built-in Chain-of-Thought (CoT) functions to create context and produce correct answers. The system we developed system operates at performance levels which match large proprietary models when we tested it on the multi-level CA-Ben benchmark, achieving Scholastic Reliability Coefficient (SRC) results which equal 68.75\% of GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet. The framework shows high efficiency and strength in handling parameters, but essential reasoning abilities fail to process complex regulatory texts which exist in fields such as Taxation.

analysis.key_results: 在CA-Ben基准上，Scholastic Reliability Coefficient达到GPT-4o和Claude 3.5 Sonnet的68.75%。
analysis.limitations: 必要推理能力无法处理税务等领域复杂的监管文本。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CA-ThinkFlow，一个参数高效的RAG框架，采用14B 4位量化推理模型和保留文档结构的Docling提取系统，在CA-Ben基准上达到与大型专有模型相当的性能。
analysis.method: 使用4位量化的14B DeepSeek-R1模型，结合布局感知的Docling文档提取和基础RAG，将检索信息加入提示，依赖模型内置思维链生成答案。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个参数高效的4位量化检索增强生成框架CA-ThinkFlow，用于特许会计领域的问答任务。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本论文聚焦于语言模型量化与检索增强生成，不涉及VLA、世界模型或机器人动作建模，无直接相关性。

papers.abstract: General-purpose coding agents can now write, debug, and refine entire robot programs, but only if they have somewhere to practice. Physical hardware is a poor practice ground: exploratory rollouts are slow to reset and, when several arms share a workspace, unsafe. Generic simulation benchmarks are safe but do not match the geometry, assets, or viewpoints of the workspace where the robot must actually work. We present CoEx (Code-driven Exploration), which lets the agent practice in an executable digital twin of its own deployment workspace. The twin is built by CoEnv, our real-to-sim framework, which reconstructs the physical scene from multi-view RGBD into a physics simulation. Inside it, a centralized code agent explores at the program level, writing a complete multi-arm program, running it in the twin, and refining it against grounded verification (privileged state checks, checkpoint predicates on risky steps, and adaptive viewpoints against inter-arm occlusion). Verified programs transfer to hardware through collision-checked deployment. On five real-world multi-arm tasks with up to three heterogeneous robots, CoEx reaches 70% average success, against 50% for the same system without the code agent (where a VLM must choose every primitive step by step), outperforms two prior VLM-planning frameworks, and produces verified episodes at 3.8-11.7x the ablated rate. Because every verified rollout is also a demonstration, exploration leaves reusable experience behind: a $\pi_{0.5}$ policy fine-tuned purely on 200 agent-generated rollouts reaches 100% and 70% real-robot success on two tasks, with no human demonstrations.

analysis.key_results: 在五个真实世界多臂任务（最多三台异构机器人）上，CoEx 平均成功率达 70%，而消融系统为 50%；超越两个先前 VLM 规划框架；验证部署的成功率是消融的 3.8-11.7 倍；利用 200 条智能体生成的演示微调 π0.5 策略，在两个任务上分别达到 100% 和 70% 的真实机器人成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 CoEx（代码驱动探索）与 CoEnv（实数到仿真框架），使编码智能体在自身工作空间的数字孪生中通过编写、调试和优化程序来完成多臂操作任务，并实现安全、可验证的物理部署。
analysis.method: CoEnv 从多视角 RGBD 重建物理场景为物理仿真环境；中心化代码智能体在此数字孪生中编写完整多臂程序、运行并通过特权状态检查、风险步骤检查点及自适应视角进行验证；验证后的程序经碰撞检查部署到实际硬件。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: CoEnv 通过代码驱动的探索在真实到仿真的数字孪生中训练多臂机器人操控，实现从虚拟验证到实际部署的高效迁移。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作通过真实到仿真的数字孪生和代码级探索生成高质量演示数据，进而微调 VLA 类策略（π0.5），证明了仿真探索经验对提升视觉-语言-动作模型的实用性，与 VLA 的数据生成和技能学习直接相关。

figures.caption: Where does the simulator sit? Left: we reconstruct the multi-arm workcell into an executable digital twin. The real cell is faithful, but every exploratory attempt risks a collision; the twin resets freely and can be explored at no cost. Right: three ways of using that twin. (a) co-training mixes simulated trajectories into the training set alongside a few real ones, and (b) sim RL optimizes a policy π θ \pi_{\theta} against simulated rollouts and a reward. Both place the simulator upstream of the data , so the policy learns from simulated experience and a sim-to-real gap has to be bridged. (c) CoEx places it upstream of the program : given only a task description, the code agent writes a multi-arm program, explores and refines it in the twin until it verifies, and the verified trajectory is then executed on the real robot, so the data collected afterwards is real.

papers.abstract: A fine-tuned Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy can easily place the alphabet soup in the basket on command, just as it saw during fine-tuning. However, if the basket is shifted five centimeters to the left, it drops the soup off the table. We developed an interpretability pipeline to investigate what such a policy is computing. Injecting task A's activations into the action expert while the policy looks at task B's scene makes $\pi_{0.5}$ execute task A's motor trajectory in 99.6\% of episodes ($n{=}1{,}968$). The injected program is bound to absolute workspace coordinates and ignores the visible scene, which provides a mechanistic account of the perturbation brittleness that concurrent benchmarks report. The binding holds on a physical UR10e: directed replay redirects the commanded task in 26/26 rollouts in one direction and 18/26 in the other, with no-injection and random-direction controls at the floor, and once the source object is moved 10-15 cm the arm grasps and releases at the recorded coordinates in 50/50 trials, picking up the wrong block when one sits there and closing on empty air when none does. Applying the same interventions to five VLAs on LIBERO, MetaWorld, SimplerEnv, and ALOHA over $420{,}000+$ rollouts yields three further findings: every architecture encodes the instruction, and four of the five weight it below vision whenever the scene alone identifies the goal; under the standard replacement write-back the SAE pooling that preserves behavior is architecture-specific ($\pi_{0.5}$ per-token, SmolVLA indifferent), and goal selection and motor generation separate into VLM and expert pathways wherever the two are distinguishable. We release \textbf{Action Atlas} (https://action-atlas.com), an interactive platform covering all 520+ trained SAEs, 79 identified concepts, and the scored UR10e rollouts. Code: https://cwru-aism.github.io/vla-interp-page/

analysis.key_results: 注入任务A的激活可使π0.5在99.6%的回合中执行任务A的动作轨迹；动作程序绑定到绝对工作空间坐标而非可见场景；在五个VLA模型上验证发现四个模型在场景能识别目标时对指令的权重低于视觉；目标选择与运动生成在可区分处分离到VLM和专家路径。
analysis.main_contribution: 开发了一个可解释性流水线，通过激活注入定位并分析了VLA策略中与任务指令和动作生成相关的内部表征，并发布了交互式平台Action Atlas。
analysis.method: 采用激活注入等干预手段，分析VLA模型内部表征，并结合多个基准（LIBERO、MetaWorld、SimplerEnv、ALOHA）和真实机器人（UR10e）进行大规模验证。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文通过可解释性干预实验揭示了微调后的视觉-语言-动作模型在扰动场景下表现脆弱的机制原因：模型可能依赖绝对工作空间坐标而非视觉场景来生成动作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究直接以视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为对象，通过机制可解释性分析揭示其内部表征和脆弱性根源，对VLA的鲁棒性和世界模型建模具有重要参考价值。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown great promise as generalist policies for a large range of relatively simple tasks. However, they demonstrate limited performance on more complex tasks, such as those requiring complex spatial or semantic understanding, manipulation in clutter, or precise manipulation. We propose OmniGuide, a flexible framework that improves VLA performance on such tasks by leveraging arbitrary sources of guidance, such as 3D foundation models, semantic-reasoning VLMs, and human pose models. We show how many kinds of guidance can be naturally expressed as differentiable energy functions with task-specific attractors and repellers located in 3D space, that influence the sampling of VLA actions. In this way, OmniGuide enables guidance sources with complementary task-relevant strengths to improve a VLA model's performance on challenging tasks. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world environments, across diverse sources of guidance, demonstrate that OmniGuide enhances the performance of state-of-the-art generalist policies (e.g., $\pi_{0.5}$, GR00T N1.6) significantly across success and safety rates. Critically, our unified framework matches or surpasses the performance of prior methods designed to incorporate specific sources of guidance into VLA policies. Project page: https://omniguide.github.io/

analysis.key_results: 在模拟和真实环境中的大量实验表明，OmniGuide显著提升了最先进通用策略（如π0.5、GR00T N1.6）的成功率和安全率；该统一框架匹配或超越了此前为特定引导源设计的专用方法。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出OmniGuide，一个灵活的框架，利用任意来源的引导（如3D基础模型、语义推理VLM、人体姿态模型）作为可微能量函数，以任务特定的吸引子和排斥子影响VLA动作采样，从而提升VLA在复杂任务上的性能。
analysis.method: 将多种引导源表达为3D空间中的可微能量函数（包含任务特定的吸引子和排斥子），并利用这些能量函数影响VLA模型的行动采样过程。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出OmniGuide框架，通过将任意引导源表达为可微能量函数来影响VLA动作采样，从而提升复杂任务性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型，旨在提升其在复杂任务中的表现，属于本站核心主题。通过引入空间引导场改进动作生成，对VLA和机器人操作有直接贡献。

For each denoising step, OmniGuide first estimates the clean action chunk 𝐀 ~ τ \tilde{\mathbf{A}}^{\tau} using the base policy 𝐯 θ \mathbf{v}_{\theta} , and maps it through differentiable kinematic models or decoders to Cartesian trajectories 𝐗 \mathbf{X} . papers.abstract: Despite rapid commercialization of surgical robots, their autonomy and real-time decision-making remain limited in practice. To address this gap, we propose ArthroCut, an autonomous policy learning framework that upgrades knee arthroplasty robots from assistive execution to context-aware action generation. ArthroCut fine-tunes a Qwen--VL backbone on a self-built, time-synchronized multimodal dataset from 21 complete cases (23,205 RGB--D pairs), integrating preoperative CT/MR, intraoperative NDI tracking of bones and end effector, RGB--D surgical video, robot state, and textual intent. The method operates on two complementary token families -- Preoperative Imaging Tokens (PIT) to encode patient-specific anatomy and planned resection planes, and Time-Aligned Surgical Tokens (TAST) to fuse real-time visual, geometric, and kinematic evidence -- and emits an interpretable action grammar under grammar/safety-constrained decoding. In bench-top experiments on a knee prosthesis across seven trials, ArthroCut achieves an average success rate of 86% over the six standard resections, significantly outperforming strong baselines trained under the same protocol. Ablations show that TAST is the principal driver of reliability while PIT provides essential anatomical grounding, and their combination yields the most stable multi-plane execution. These results indicate that aligning preoperative geometry with time-aligned intraoperative perception and translating that alignment into tokenized, constrained actions is an effective path toward robust, interpretable autonomy in orthopedic robotic surgery.

analysis.key_results: 在膝关节假体台架实验中，七次试验平均成功率达86%，显著优于同协议训练的强基线；消融显示TAST是可靠性的主要驱动，PIT提供必要解剖定位，二者结合实现最稳定多平面执行。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ArthroCut框架，将膝关节置换机器人从辅助执行升级为上下文感知的自主动作生成，融合术前影像与术中多模态数据，并采用语法/安全约束解码输出可解释动作。
analysis.method: 微调Qwen-VL骨干网络，构建了来自21例完整手术、包含23,205对RGB-D及多模态数据的数据集，设计了术前影像令牌（PIT）与时间对齐手术令牌（TAST）的融合，并通过语法/安全约束解码生成动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ArthroCut是一个自主策略学习框架，通过微调视觉语言模型并融合术前影像与术中多模态数据，实现膝关节置换机器人骨切除的上下文感知动作生成。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文核心是使用视觉语言模型（VLA）进行机器人手术操作策略学习，直接将VLA应用于真实机器人骨切除任务，属于VLA在机器人操作领域的典型应用，与本站VLA主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Dynamic runtime latency and memory constraints necessitate flexible large language model (LLM) deployment, where an LLM can be inferred with various quantization precisions based on available computational resources. Recent work on such any-precision quantization either relies on hardware-inefficient vector quantization or induces additional scaling factors when switching between bit-widths. Meanwhile, existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods calibrated for a fixed low precision show poor generalizability under runtime precision change. In this work, we attribute the source of poor generalization across bit-widths to a precision-dependent outlier migration phenomenon where the distribution of PTQ-sensitive tokens changes across precisions. Motivated by this observation, we propose MoBiQuant, a novel any-precision Mixture-of-Bits quantization framework that adjusts weight precision for flexible LLM inference based on token sensitivity. Specifically, we propose a many-in-one recursive residual quantization that can iteratively reconstruct higher-precision weights at runtime and mitigates outlier migration with a token-aware router to dynamically select the optimal inference precision of each token.Extensive experiments show that MoBiQuant matches or surpasses frontier single-precision PTQ while exhibiting strong elasticity, achieving significant memory savings and throughput gains of up to $1.34\times$ over state-of-the-art any-precision methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/SimWangArizona/MoBiQuant.

analysis.key_results: 匹配或超越前沿单精度PTQ方法，相比最先进的任意精度方法实现高达1.34倍的吞吐量提升和显著内存节省。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出MoBiQuant，一种令牌自适应的任意精度混合位数量化框架，包含多合一递归残差量化和令牌感知路由器，以缓解精度相关的离群点迁移现象，匹配或超越单精度PTQ方法并提升吞吐量。
analysis.method: 使用多合一递归残差量化迭代重建高精度权重，结合令牌感知路由器动态选择每个令牌的最佳推理精度。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出MoBiQuant任意精度量化框架，通过混合位数量化和令牌感知路由解决跨位宽泛化问题，实现灵活的大模型内存与吞吐量优化。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于任意精度量化这一独立高效推理主题，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人领域，但对模型量化技术在机器人政策或世界模型中的应用具有潜在的方法学参考价值。

figures.caption: (Left) Existing PTQ methods poorly generalize under calibration–inference precision mismatch, e.g., inference at 4-bit with 3-bit calibrated parameters ( green vs. red ). papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance in language-centric tasks. However, in agentic settings, LLMs often struggle to anticipate action consequences and adapt to environment dynamics, highlighting the need for world-modeling capabilities in LLM-based agents. We propose Reinforcement World Model Learning (RWML), a self-supervised method that learns action-conditioned world models for LLM-based agents on textual states using sim-to-real gap rewards. Our method aligns simulated next states produced by the model with realized next states observed from the environment, encouraging consistency between internal world simulations and actual environment dynamics in a pre-trained embedding space. Unlike next-state token prediction, which prioritizes token-level fidelity (i.e., reproducing exact wording) over semantic equivalence and can lead to model collapse, our method provides a more robust training signal and is empirically less susceptible to reward hacking than LLM-as-a-judge. We evaluate our method on ALFWorld and $\tau^2$ Bench and observe significant gains over the base model, despite using no expert data, task-success rewards, or strong-LLM annotations - only an off-the-shelf embedding model as a distance metric. When combined with task-success rewards, our method outperforms direct task-success reward RL by 6.9 and 5.7 points on ALFWorld and $\tau^2$ Bench respectively; it further outperforms expert-data training on ALFWorld and is comparable to it on $\tau^2$ Bench.

analysis.key_results: 在ALFWorld和τ² Bench上相比基座模型显著提升；与任务成功奖励结合时，分别超过直接任务成功奖励RL 6.9和5.7分；在ALFWorld上超过专家数据训练，在τ² Bench上与之相当。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出RWML，一种自监督方法，利用模拟-真实差距奖励为LLM智能体学习动作条件世界模型，并在无专家数据、任务成功奖励或强LLM标注的情况下显著提升性能。
analysis.method: RWML使用自监督学习，通过模拟-真实差距奖励对齐模型生成的模拟下一状态与环境中观察到的真实下一状态，在预训练嵌入空间中鼓励内部世界模拟与实际环境动态的一致性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种自监督方法RWML，通过模拟-真实差距奖励为基于文本状态的LLM智能体学习动作条件世界模型。

papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance in long-horizon agentic tasks through multi-step interaction and reasoning at test time. However, repeatedly invoking these models incurs substantial inference cost over an episode. Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces this cost, but using a fixed low precision throughout an episode can sharply lower task success. We observe that interaction steps differ sharply in their sensitivity to quantization: given the same context, decoding a step at low precision turns a success into a failure at only about 1% of the steps, which we call critical steps. Based on this observation, we propose Dynamic Mixed-Precision Routing (DMR), a framework that adaptively selects between high-precision and low-precision versions of the same LLM at each decision step. Leveraging an entire-space factorization to jointly predict a step's divergence and its effect on the outcome, DMR learns to recognize these critical steps by training only a lightweight router on the model's hidden state. By reusing a shared high-precision KV cache and the hidden states, DMR avoids redundant context prefill and a separate text encoder, enabling precision switching with less than 1 ms of overhead per step and adding less than 0.11% to step latency for routing. This mixed-precision design also enables nested quantization, reducing the memory footprint by 39% on average compared with FP16. Across three long-horizon agentic benchmarks with nested quantization, DMR achieves an average 2.44x decode speedup over FP16 at comparable task success rates, without fine-tuning the underlying model. On ALFWorld with GPTQ, DMR achieves a 1.71x decode speedup with 86.9% success, compared with 87.2% for FP16.

analysis.key_results: 在三个长时程智能体基准上，嵌套量化下DMR相比FP16实现平均2.44倍解码加速；在ALFWorld上达到86.9%成功率，FP16为87.2%，解码加速1.71倍；路由开销小于1ms，占步骤延迟不到0.11%；内存占用平均降低39%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出动态混合精度路由（DMR）框架，通过轻量级路由器预测关键步骤，在保持任务成功率的同时实现混合精度切换，减少推理成本。
analysis.method: 利用全空间分解联合预测步骤发散性和结果影响，训练轻量路由器识别关键步骤；复用高精度KV缓存和隐藏状态避免冗余预填充和额外文本编码器，支持精度切换开销小于1ms；同时支持嵌套量化以降低内存占用。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出动态混合精度路由框架DMR，在每个决策步骤自适应选择高/低精度LLM版本，以减少长时程智能体任务中的推理成本并保持任务成功率。

papers.abstract: Language-conditioned goal navigation requires embodied agents to locate user-specified targets without step-by-step guidance. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on category-level goals or rely on instance descriptions generated by vision-language models, which often contain ambiguities and semantic errors, limiting systematic and reliable evaluation. We introduce HieraNav, an open-vocabulary navigation task with goals at four hierarchical semantic levels: scene, room, region, and instance. We present Language as a Map (LangMap), the first goal navigation benchmark to enrich real-world indoor 3D scans with human-verified semantic annotations supporting tasks across all four goal levels. Built on HM3D using a contrastive annotation protocol that compares same-scene regions and instances, LangMap provides region labels and discriminative region and instance descriptions covering 414 object categories and contains over 18K tasks. Each target has concise and detailed descriptions, enabling evaluation across instruction styles. Automated and human evaluations validate our annotation quality: our descriptions improve text-to-view matching accuracy over GOAT-Bench's by 23 points on all shared annotated instances, and an independent human audit yields 92.5% unique-and-correct matches. We also propose PlaNaVid, an RGB-only baseline that combines Bounded Diverse Memory with high-level planning to prime a reactive policy for multi-goal navigation, achieving top-tier success rates without depth, 3D scene representations, or object masks. Further analyses reveal that exploration and hierarchical disambiguation failures become more prominent at finer goal levels, while long-tail categories, small objects, distant targets, timely stopping, and multi-goal completion remain challenging. Benchmark and code: https://bo-miao.github.io/LangMap

analysis.key_results: 文本到视角匹配准确率比GOAT-Bench在共享标注实例上提高23个百分点；独立人工审计得到92.5%的唯一且正确匹配率；PlaNaVid在无深度、无3D场景表示、无物体掩码的情况下取得领先成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 构建了一个人工验证的分层开放词汇目标导航基准LangMap，包含场景、房间、区域和实例四个语义级别的导航任务，并提供高质量的区域标签和区分性描述。
analysis.method: 采用对比标注协议，在HM3D数据集上为真实世界室内3D扫描添加人工验证的语义注释，覆盖414个对象类别，生成超过18K个任务；同时提出结合Bounded Diverse Memory与高层规划的RGB-only基线PlaNaVid。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出一个基于真实室内3D扫描的人工验证基准LangMap，用于四个语义层级上的开放词汇目标导航任务，并配套一个仅RGB的基线方法PlaNaVid。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a unified paradigm for robotic perception and control, enabling emergent generalization and long-horizon task execution. However, their deployment in dynamic, real-world environments is severely hindered by high inference latency. While smooth robotic interaction requires control frequencies of 20-30 Hz, current VLA models typically operate at only 3-5 Hz on edge devices due to the memory-bound nature of autoregressive decoding. Existing optimizations often require extensive retraining or compromise model accuracy. To bridge this gap, we introduce ActionFlow, a system-level inference framework tailored for resource-constrained edge platforms. At the core of ActionFlow is a Cross-Request Pipelining strategy, a novel scheduler that redefines VLA inference as a macro-pipeline of micro-requests. The strategy intelligently batches memory-bound Decode phases with compute-bound Prefill phases across continuous time steps to maximize hardware utilization. Furthermore, to support this scheduling, we propose a Cross-Request State Packed Forward operator and a Unified KV Ring Buffer, which fuse fragmented memory operations into efficient dense computations. Experimental results demonstrate that ActionFlow achieves a 2.55x improvement in FPS on the OpenVLA-7B model without retraining, enabling real-time dynamic manipulation on edge hardware. Our work is available at https://github.com/Frankd35/Action-Flow.

analysis.key_results: 在OpenVLA-7B模型上无需重训练，FPS提升2.55倍，能在边缘硬件上实现实时动态操作。

analysis.method: Cross-Request Pipelining 将VLA推理重构为微请求宏流水线，智能混合Decode与Prefill阶段；Cross-Request State Packed Forward算子融合内存碎片操作；Unified KV Ring Buffer统一管理KV缓存。

papers.abstract: Tensor-train (TT) compression reduces neural-network parameters, but the latency of a tensorized layer is set by its contraction order and its mapping onto hardware: a contraction path with fewer multiply-accumulate operations (MACs) is not necessarily faster on a systolic array. We present a deployment-constrained, latency-guided design space exploration (DSE) framework for fixed-rank tensorized neural networks (TNNs) under a fixed processing-element (PE) budget. Using MAC-guided path pruning, it evaluates feasible combinations of contraction paths, three PE-array partitions, and input-, output-, and weight-stationary dataflows. By minimizing the sum of inference and training latency estimates, it selects a single physical PE partition shared across layers and both modes, while allowing layer- and mode-specific paths and dataflows. On ResNet-18 and ViT-Ti/4, 25%-50% of the layers select a path other than the minimum-MAC one, the best dataflow varies across layers and models, and on a representative ViT layer the latency-selected candidate reduces simulated latency by 23.5% relative to the minimum-MAC candidate. Deployed on a Xilinx VU9P FPGA accelerator that supports both inference and training, the complete TT+INT8 system achieves 3.28x-4.00x inference and 3.42x-3.85x training speedups over dense implementations with the same PE budget.

analysis.key_results: 在ResNet-18和ViT-Ti/4上，25%-50%的层选择了非最小MAC路径；代表性ViT层的延迟选择候选比最小MAC候选降低23.5%的模拟延迟；在Xilinx VU9P FPGA上，完整的TT+INT8系统相比同PE预算的密集实现，推理加速3.28-4.00倍，训练加速3.42-3.85倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一个部署约束、延迟引导的设计空间探索框架，用于在固定PE预算下为固定秩张量化神经网络优化收缩路径、PE阵列划分和数据流，以最小化推理与训练延迟。
analysis.method: 使用MAC引导的路径剪枝，评估可行的收缩路径、三种PE阵列划分以及输入、输出和权重静态数据流组合，选择跨层和模式共享的物理PE划分，同时允许层和模式特定的路径与数据流。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种部署约束、延迟引导的设计空间探索框架，用于在固定PE预算下为固定秩张量化神经网络选择最优收缩路径、PE阵列划分和数据流。

papers.abstract: Multimodal agents built on large vision-language models are increasingly deployed in open-world settings but remain highly vulnerable to prompt injection. Typographic text-in-image attacks such as FigStep have been evaluated mainly on standalone vision-language models. For agents, user goals, webpage context, and action history make the effect of embedded instructions uncertain, and robustness to behavior-guided, adaptive visual injections remains insufficiently studied. We introduce AgentTypo, a black-box red-teaming framework that launches adaptive typographic prompt injection by embedding optimized text into webpage images. We formulate an attention-guided automatic typographic prompt-injection objective that favors the attacker's expected answer over the clean-page answer, together with task-conditioned visual attention from small question-answering models. A novel black-box optimization method searches text position, contrast, and color. To further strengthen the attack, we develop a multi-LLM system that iteratively refines injection prompts using evaluation feedback and retrieves successful past examples for strategy learning. Experiments on the VWA-Adv and Mind2Web benchmarks show that AgentTypo significantly outperforms state-of-the-art image-based prompt injection attacks. Across seven closed- and open-source model backends, AgentTypo-pro achieves 45%-83% ASR, outperforming the CLIP-based AgentAttack by 29-47% and previous typographic attacks by 25%-37% on VWA-Adv.

analysis.key_results: 在VWA-Adv和Mind2Web基准上，AgentTypo显著优于现有图像提示注入攻击；在VWA-Adv上，AgentTypo-pro在七个闭源和开源模型后端上达到45%-83%的ASR，超过CLIP-based AgentAttack 29-47%，超过先前排版攻击25%-37%。

analysis.method: 利用注意力引导的自动排版提示注入目标，结合小型问答模型的任务条件视觉注意力，通过黑盒优化搜索文本位置、对比度和颜色，并使用多LLM系统迭代优化注入提示。

papers.abstract: Post-training LLM compression often relies on low-rank approximations, which force all columns of a projection matrix to share a single low-dimensional subspace. We propose CoSpaDi, a training-free compression framework that replaces this single-subspace assumption with a union-of-subspaces model via sparse dictionary learning. CoSpaDi factorizes each weight matrix into a dense dictionary and column-sparse coefficients, allowing different columns to select different subsets of dictionary atoms at the same storage budget. To preserve model behavior, we use calibration activations to transform functional reconstruction into a standard dictionary learning problem. Across LLaMA and Qwen models, CoSpaDi improves accuracy-compression and perplexity-compression trade-offs over SVD-based and structured pruning baselines at 20-40\% compression ratios, while naturally supporting sparse-dense computation and post-training quantization of sparse coefficients.

analysis.key_results: 在LLaMA和Qwen模型上，CoSpaDi在20-40%压缩比下，相比SVD和结构化剪枝基线提升了精度-压缩和困惑度-压缩的权衡。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CoSpaDi，一种训练-free的LLM压缩框架，将权重矩阵分解为稠密字典和列稀疏系数，用联合子空间模型替代低秩近似的单一共享子空间假设。
analysis.method: 使用校准激活将功能重建转化为标准字典学习问题，对每个权重矩阵分解为稠密字典和列稀疏系数，不同列可选择不同字典原子子集，并支持稀疏-稠密计算和系数量化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种训练-free的LLM压缩框架CoSpaDi，用稀疏字典学习替代低秩共享子空间假设，以提升压缩效率并支持量化。
